in_sanskrit.name: वेदश्री
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the abode of Vedas and knowledge

in_hindi.name: वेदश्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिसका अधिष्ठान वेद और ज्ञान है

in_marathi.name: Vedashri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedashri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words: 'Veda' meaning knowledge and 'Shri' meaning river, representing a river of divine knowledge.

in_bengali.name: Vedashri
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Knowledge River
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vedashri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words: 'Veda' meaning knowledge and 'Shri' meaning river, representing a river of divine knowledge.
